content: Jon yaage bisemu nigigou, no beele malalamudu lewai.
Beele beha, Itou Idau Yesus Kristus nomo hilou beele.

Hilou beele beha, profet Aisaia no yeregai onounga, no amugedu heigaiha, “Isau. Ji fai ete yame beele malalamudu lewei nomo boni, amuge hinidu, huuru tuwehenga goyonbona. Ono wehenga, no ne name jala haiya hanonbona.
Ha fai uwau langa, fai hurau ete no yauredu benou lewai, ‘Anyakaro nomo jala haiya fuwagu. Nomo jala tiginimu fuwagu.’”

Jon yaage bisemu nigigou fai, no ha ete fai uwau langa heigaiha, no fai-aita bagu huwanyanege ubuludu bode, yaage bisou togonga, Itou no nebere une uulu nagonbona, waha bona beele malalamudu lenigaiha.
Ono wainga, Judia bagu, Jerusalem fai-aita bagu oruwanga, nere Jon bagu goidu, nebere une uulu wanenga, Jon no nere Jordan yaage langa, yaage bisemu nigaiha.
Jon no kolos Kamel osoko langa atane waha tagugai, no let ungu langa tagugai. Ariya, no dongamu nomo koisi ameme bagu nyigai.

No beele malalamudu, benou lewaiha, “Fai ete no ji mogofe maina waha, no nomo danga ji yame danga feiya tuwou. Onou waha bona, ji afefe tuburu kutudu boni no nomo su nomo maalu dagou waha, futu fuwei nomo ji fai hilou uwa.
Ji tere yaage langa, yaage bisemu tigi-tigini. Ariya, no tere Hauri Guuni langa, yaage bisemu tigonbona.”
Jon no Yesus yaage bisemu tuwai.
Saini waha langa, Yesus no Nasaret taon, Galili distrik awadu bona mayaiha. Ono wainga, Jon no Yesus Jordan yaage langa, yaage bisemu tuwaiha.
Ono wainga, Yesus no yaage awadu ouwe langa maidu bona, no fasayadu, ha laluwa helufa wainga uraiha, ono gainga, Hauri Guuni neei buuna dorofe no bagu mai.
Ono gainga, ha laluwa langa, fai belenege ete no benou yauredu lewai, “Ne yame magana, Ji ne gaude hinini. Ji yame huwanyafe ne bona edega dena.”
Satan no Yesus wala-wala tuwai.
Saini waha langa tigini, Hauri Guuni no Yesus huuru tuwainga, ha fai uwau langa goyaiha.
Onodu Yesus no ha fai uwau langa fati 40 yafa gainga, Satan no wala-wala tuwaiha. No kaafa kui bagu yafa ganenga, ensel nere, no hoyo tuwaneha.
Yesus no Galili langa haruwe hugu warai.
Saini nere, Jon dagou mata langa tafa tuwane yafa gainga, Yesus no Galili distrik langa mai heigedu bona, no Itou nomo hilou beele malalamudu lewaiha.

No benou lewai, “Itou no saini hangada wai waha, no amina heigaha, onodu Itou nomo huuna langa yafou waha, no mai jugu waha. Tere huwanyatege ubuludu bonade, hilou beele bonade, huwanyatege ngalengawou.”
Yesus no fai aise yaure nigainga no oojo tuwaneha.
Yesus no, Galili yaage katiwou mou langa golo bona, Saimon bemu Andru ngare neriraiha. Nere yaage katiwou langa, hagoma ayawou haruwe tare. Nere hoowe langa moni kusewei nomo haruwe tetedere.
Ono garenga, Yesus no benou lenirai, “Tere maidu ji oojo hiyaderenga, ji tere fai-aita bagu elege nigei nomo isisiwou tiron boni.”
Ono wainga, nere fasayadu bodere, hagoma dada waanga awaru ware oto gainga, nere goidu Yesus oojo tuwareha.
Onodu Yesus no menanga onou golodu goi bona, Sebedi idau gane nga nononga, Jems Jon ngare nerirai. Nere bot langa yafa bodere, neire hagoma dada koraiwai waha erere bodere yafare.
Ono garenga, Yesus no nere yaure nirainga, nere amenere Sebedi haruwe fai bagu bot langa awa nigidu bodere, Yesus oojo tuwareha.
Yesus no fai ete langa hauri inyaba so tuwai.
Yesus no fai ila bagu Kaperneam taon langa goyane. Onodu bode, saini nere Juda nebere bori nomo fati heigainga, Yesus no bori mata huwanya langa goidu, fai-aita bagu beele malalamudu lenigaiha.

Ono wainga, fai-aita bagu nere Yesus nomo beele isidu bode, horoto dewaneha, taate bona, Yesus no fai-aita bagu isisiwou nigai wa, nere Nuuni beele isou fai ono-onode dorofe uwa. Yesus no fai unyi bagu dorofe, isisiwou nigaiha.
Saini waha langa, fai ete no nebere bori mata huwanya langa yafai wa, hauri inyaba ete no langa inyai. Onodu no benou yaurai,
“Yesus Nasaretha, ne ere adadu ono higau ganga mainaha? Ne ere inyabamu higau ganga rute mainaha? Ji ne isi hinini. Ne fai hilobainga tigini beha, ne Itou nogo langa mainaha.”
Ono wainga, Yesus no hauri inyaba waha honggoro tubona benou letuwai, “Ne hurate fosokodu bonahe, fai waha awa tuwau.”
Ono wainga, hauri inyaba fai waha waridu bunyu banyi tudu bona, inyangaro uidu, fai waha awa tuwaiha.

Ono wainga, nere fai-aita bagu oruwanga waha uredu bode, horoto wane. Onodu bode, nere nage-nage benou leguruwane, “Taate dada elebe beha heigena? Fai beha no beele eege ete malalamudu lena, onodu no beele lena waha, no fai unyi bagu dorofe. Onodu, saini no hauri inyaba beele lenigi ganga, nere nomo beele isi-iside.”
Ono wainga, Yesus no dada onowai waha nomo beele, fasayadu Galili distrik oruwanga la, golo boro waiha.
Yesus no Pita tangabumu aita taura jigemu fuwai.
Yesus no fai ila bagu bori mata awadu bode malala heigedu, nere tigininga Andru Saimon ngare neire mata langa goyane. Ono ganenga, Jems Jon ngare fere, nere gaara goyaneha.
Saimon tangabumu aita, no kabalila agore inyaiha, taate bona, no taura tubona, gogala ngasu kuruwai. Ono wainga nere fasayadu onou Saimon tangabumu aita taura tuwai waha, Yesus letuwanenga isai.
Ono wanenga, Yesus no Saimon tangabumu aita bagu goidu bona, owo yaasudu jaimu tuwai. Ono wainga, Saimon tangabumu aita no taura jige tuwainga, nebere da haiya nagaiha.
Yesus no fai-aita bagu baingaro taura jigemu nagaiha.
Esuwa hoonga mani joro gainga, nere taura fai baingaro hanigedu bode, Yesus bagu mayane. Fai-aita hauri inyaba bagu fere onounga, hanigedu bode mayaneha.
Nere taon wahaha fai-aita bagu oruwanga, mai mata waha jauli arasai hinomu langa komo waneha.

Ono wanenga, Yesus no fai-aita baingaro, taura hogo fere-fere bagu waha, nebere taura jigemu nagai. Ono bona, hauri inyaba baingaro so nigaiha. Hauri inyaba nere Yesus bode alai, waha bona, nere beele lewoguga bona, Yesus no nere karu nigaiha.
Yesus no Galili langa golowai.
Eringe hamba oruwa, Yesus no jaidu malala langa heigedu bona, haumu ete fai uwau langa goidu, walanga hauya bona yafaiha.
Ono gainga, iinga, Saimon no ilibumu gane bagu goidu, no kuru tuwane.
Nere goi toroba tudu bode, Yesus benou letuwane, “Nere fai-aita toomaro, ne kuru hinide.”
Ono wanenga, Yesus no benou lenigai, “Buyona, ere taon jugu-jugu inyide waha langa goyo boya. Ji nere fere beele malalamudu le nigon boni, taate bona, ji haruwe beha tei nomo boni meeneha.”
Onodu, Yesus no Galili distrik oruwa langa kolilidu golo bona, nebere bori mata huwanya langa goidu, beele malalamudu leniginga bona, hauri inyaba so nigaiha.
Yesus no fai ete lepra taura bagu, jigemu tuwai.

Fai ete no lepra taura bagu, maidu bona Yesus danga bagu isoki tuwai. Fai waha, no afo tuburu kutudu yafa bona, Yesus benou letuwai, “Ne gau hinei mata wonga, ne edo langa, ji figini hiyahenga, Itou ago langa eege heigon boni.”
Ono wainga, Yesus no fai waha bona danga bagu aau warainga, owo jaula langa tafa bona, benou letuwai, “Ji gau hina. Ne eege heigau.”
Ono wainga, fasayadu onou lepra taura, fai waha awa tuwainga, fai waha no eege heigaiha.
Ono wainga, Yesus no fai waha, fasayadu huuru tuwainga goi gainga, beele danga bagu

benou letuwai, “Ure dewau. Ne fai ete te, dada ne langa heigaha beha adai hai fuwau. Uwa. Ne goidu bonahe, name geete gala pris abitimu tuwau, onodu, ne name geete gala eege heigaha waha abitimuwou, Moses lewai onou eeya muru warau. Ono wahenga, nere fai-aita bagu ne name taura jige hinaha, iwou isodbode.”

Ariya, fai waha no goidu bona, dada oruwanga no gogala langa heigai waha, fai-aita bagu hai nagai. No aasa waha, ha-ha oruwa langa hai nagai. Onou bona, Yesus no nere fai-aita bagu agenege langa, taon ete huwanya goyei nomo edo uwa. No ewe dui langanga, ulate fai uwau langa yafai. Ono gainga, ha-ha fai-aita bagu oruwanga, no bagu mayaneha.
